# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.66

- **Linux binaries are now built on Ubuntu 26.04** (x86-64 and ARM64), like the rest of the CI (`*-linux-gnu.tar.gz`). They need the glibc of Ubuntu 26.04 or newer.
- **Extra builds for older Linux** (x86-64 and ARM64), built on Ubuntu 22.04: `*-linux-gnu-glibc2.35.tar.gz`. They need glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04 and later, Debian 12 and later); the release fails if one of them needs anything newer. Pick these if the other Linux files do not start on your system. Windows and macOS builds are unchanged.
- The release workflow prints the glibc version each Linux binary needs.

Known: the old-Linux builds are not run on a 22.04 system by the workflow beyond the smoke test on the same runner.
